This article describes different methods for removing a bookmark from your Firefox browser. 

* For more information on using bookmarks, see [[Create bookmarks to save your favorite webpages]].

{note}If you've set up [[How do I choose what types of information to sync on Firefox? | Firefox Sync]] to synchronize your bookmarks, the bookmarks you remove from one device will also be deleted from your synchronized devices.{/note}

__TOC__

= Deleting a single bookmark =
# Go to the page in your bookmarks that you want to remove.
# Click on the star icon to the right of your search bar. 
# In the ''Edit Bookmark'' window, click {button Remove Bookmark}.
#;[[Image:Remove bookmark Fx89]] 


= Deleting more than one bookmark or folder =
#[[T:OpenBookmarksLibrary]]
# In the left pane, click on the folder you want to view. Its contents will appear in the right pane.
# In the right pane, click to select the item you want to delete. {for win,linux}Hold down the {key CTRL} key to select more than one item.{/for}{for mac}Hold down the {key command} key to select more than one item.{/for} 
# With the items to be deleted selected, click on the {for win,linux}{button Organize} button{/for}{for mac}[[Image:d7a1d14cc7b5aa780656b5967aad6fbf-1252026590-54-1.png]] icon{/for} and then select {menu Delete}.
